reviewer_added_requests.discovery_reason: Async-job-design owns durable acceptance, job identity, scheduling, retry, cancellation, progress, overload, and terminal recovery while defining a material lifecycle of queued, running, cancelling, failed, exhausted, and repaired work. State-machine-modeling owns state invariants, transition authority, guards, concurrency, side effects, time, and forbidden paths, so full material is required to establish the job-specific versus general lifecycle boundary.

Data-middleware-change-builder implements stateful database, cache, queue, search, migration, and recovery changes, while data-api-contract-changer owns public API, schema, and migration contract transitions with consumer and compatibility evidence. Full candidate material is required to determine when an internal stateful change crosses into a public data-contract transition that the middleware builder cannot close alone.

Event-driven-architecture defines event meaning, producer-consumer topology, schema evolution, mixed consumer versions, replay, and compatibility evidence, while contract-testing owns executable provider-consumer proof across named versions and retained or replayed payloads. Full material is required to prevent topology or schema evidence from being treated as complete compatibility proof.

Event-driven-architecture owns delivery identity, duplicate and replay behavior, backpressure, and terminal recovery at the event topology level, while idempotency-retry-design owns operation identity, record-effect crash windows, concurrent states, aggregate retry budgets, late replay, and terminal resolution. Full material is required to distinguish event-flow architecture from the detailed repeat-effect safety contract.

Event-driven-architecture selects a consistency boundary and coordinates state change with publication across loss and duplication windows, while transaction-consistency owns the named invariant, atomic scope, isolation, effect ordering, conflicts, and recovery proof. Full material is required to verify when an event topology decision must delegate its state-publication consistency mechanism.

Indexing-query-optimization owns query plans, indexes, filters, sorting, read paths, and internal pagination mechanics, while api-contract-design owns consumer-visible pagination and completion semantics, compatibility, and proof limits. Full material is required to ensure a query optimization preserves the public cursor, ordering, continuation, and result semantics instead of redefining them as an internal plan choice.

Message-queue-design owns broker topology, acknowledgement, ordering, retries, dead letters, replay, and terminal disposition, while domain-event-modeling owns the business fact, authoritative producer, commit timing, subject and payload contract, compatibility, and consumer meaning. Full material is required to protect the transport-delivery versus domain-event-semantics boundary.

Message-queue-design chooses retry or no-retry behavior, poison-message handling, terminal disposition, and recovery ownership, while failure-contract-design owns stable retryable, terminal, partial, degraded, timeout, and cancellation meanings and explicitly leaves queue disposition to the queue specialist. Full material is required to verify their classification-versus-mechanics handoff.

Search-analytics-design distinguishes authoritative, derived, and mixed surfaces and owns ingestion, freshness, rebuild, relevance, and metric semantics while leaving source meaning to its owner, whereas data-model-design owns authoritative persisted identity, relationships, lifecycle, and invariants. Full material is required to establish the source-model versus derived-search or analytical-model boundary.

Search-analytics-design requires visibility enforcement before results, counts, facets, aggregations, or retrieved context reach callers and rejects post-query authorization, while permission-boundary-modeling owns authoritative visibility predicates, object and tenant scope, collection and bulk semantics, denial disclosure, and negative proof. Full material is required despite the low lexical rank because this is a critical authorization boundary.
